ideas.title: Following the Money in the Minnesota COVID Meal Fraud Investigation
ideas.description: Investigate the financial trail of the alleged COVID meal fraud in Minnesota, including the role of Ilhan Omar and other officials
questions: What is the extent of Ilhan Omar's involvement in the alleged COVID meal fraud?
How much money was allegedly misused?
ideas.insight: This story has the potential to uncover a large-scale fraud scheme, and I recommend using data analysis and public records to track the money trail.
